gloss: to confine; to shut in; to cram in

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {押|お}し{込|こ}めませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {押|お}し{込|こ}めていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {押|お}し{込|こ}めていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to confine, to shut in, to lock away
definitions.explanation: To force someone or something into a confined space and keep them there. Can be used for physical confinement or figurative suppression.

definitions.gloss: to cram in, to stuff in, to force into
definitions.explanation: To push or force something into a tight or limited space.

examples.english: They confined the criminal in a room.

notes:
Ichidan verb ({一段動詞|いちだんどうし}).
- Negative: ⟦{押|お}し{込|こ}めない→押し込む：04237_oshikomu⟧
- Polite: ⟦{押|お}し{込|こ}め→押し込む：04237_oshikomu⟧ます
- Te-form: ⟦{押|お}し{込|こ}め→押し込む：04237_oshikomu⟧て
- Past: ⟦{押|お}し{込|こ}め→押し込む：04237_oshikomu⟧た
- Passive: ⟦{押|お}し{込|こ}め→押し込む：04237_oshikomu⟧られる

USAGE:
The passive form ⟦{押|お}し{込|こ}め→押し込む：04237_oshikomu⟧られる is very common, especially for describing being stuck or confined somewhere against one's will. The figurative usage in sense 1 (suppressing emotions) is also frequent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}し{込|こ}める: to confine in a room
- ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{込|こ}める: to suppress feelings
- ⟦スーツケース→スーツケース：01781_suutsukeesu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}し{込|こ}める: to cram into a suitcase
